entry.title: AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D Review - The Best Just Got Better
entry.content:
AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D Review - The Best Just Got Better
The AMD Ryzen 9850X3D builds on the already excellent 9800X3D without trying to shake up the market. Instead, it focuses on refining what already works. AMD delivers modest improvements with smarter tuning, and the same cache magic that gamers love. Thanks to a reasonable price increase, this processor will be a no-brainer pick for future high-end gaming rigs.

Intel Panther Lake Technical Deep Dive
Panther Lake is Intel’s new mobile architecture built on the 18A process, featuring RibbonFET transistors, PowerVia backside power delivery, and Foveros-S packaging. With new Cougar Cove and Darkmont cores, Xe3 graphics, and smarter AI, it’s Intel’s most advanced design yet—our writeup breaks down the tech and explains how it all works.
